title: Plain Naan Prices Rise to Rs. 35 in Lahore
excerpt: The cost of a plain naan in Lahore has increased by Rs. 5, bringing the new price to Rs. 35.
body_html: Residents in Lahore are facing higher food costs as the price of a plain naan has increased. According to recent reports, the price went up by Rs. 5, bringing the total cost for a single plain naan to Rs. 35.
